name: Trunk City 2000
description: A pixel-art city for each radio system, built from its talkgroups. Every call sends someone out: fire trucks, ambulances, buses, plows. Now and then, a flying saucer comes for a cow.

screenshots.caption: Radios on the air as vehicles and buildings, glowing with their names while they talk
Four systems at once, each with its own headlines
City Planning: which systems and talkgroups count, and what each one is
